annotations.text:
EDITORIAL — Kreami screens

Type: Instrument Serif for titles and every numeral, Archivo for body and metadata. Ink #17130F on #FAF7F1, one burgundy accent, hairline rules instead of cards.

ZERO WITHOUT THE STRIKE
Five empty dollops read as 0/5 because the accent-colored numeral always sits beside them — see Jury duty on the home feed and Dana on the thread.

CONTRAST CORRECTED (2026-08-25)
The neutrals failed WCAG AA and are darkened here: metadata is now #786F66 (4.61:1) and the unfilled dollop #958D82 (3.06:1). The old #B0A597 tone is gone — it and #8C8177 could not both pass and stay distinguishable, so secondary hierarchy is size and weight now, not colour. The A/B/C direction study keeps the original palette as the record of that decision.

OPEN
The dollop glyph is still a first pass. It carries the whole brand and deserves more iteration than it has had.

COMPOSE — two steps, left to right

1 WHAT — one field, results appear from the second keystroke. Each result shows its average and count, so joining a populated thread is more attractive than typing a new one.

2 RATE — six tap targets, 48px, no slider. The note is optional and the button says so by not mentioning it.

MATCHING RULE (revised): an exact match ignoring case joins that thread and cannot create a duplicate. Anything else becomes a new experience, with no confirmation step. That makes this search list the ONLY thing preventing near-duplicate threads — so it has to be fast, generous, and impossible to miss. Rank it by similarity, break ties by Kreami count.

The bottom third of screen 1 is intentionally bare: the real keyboard occupies it.

DEFERRED — not in v1

The fuzzy-match confirmation step. Kept as a drawn screen because it is the obvious remedy if near-duplicate experiences turn out to be a real problem in the beta, but nothing routes here under the exact-match rule.

PROFILE & SOCIAL

AVERAGE KREAM GIVEN sits in a ruled band on both profiles — it is the personality stat. Manish reads 3.4; Dana reads 1.9 in the accent, which tells you who she is before you read a single Kreami.

Own profile gets an outlined Edit profile; someone else's gets the filled burgundy Follow. Only one filled button per screen, so the primary action is never ambiguous.

Follow states: filled = not following, outlined = following. Rows carry each person's average so the list is decidable rather than just a directory — remove that line if it reads as clutter.

PROFILE PHOTO has two entry points: a camera badge on your own avatar, and a Profile photo row at the top of Settings. Avatars are the one image the v1 storage budget covers — the no-photos rule applies to Kreamis, not to profile pictures.

KREAMI ROWS now carry likes, replies, age, and the experience's average and count — the same widgets as the home feed, in the profile's tighter layout. The remaining difference is deliberate: the feed needs a person's name and avatar on every card, a profile does not.

Settings covers only what the design docs actually commit to: the 30-day handle cooldown, the public-and-permanent notice, and working account deletion.

NOT DESIGNED YET: block, report, the edit-profile form, and the photo cropper.
